sources.selection: One representative for each actually listed stage: oracle bone, bronze, Chu slips/silk, Shuowen small seal, Qin slips, clerical script, and separately labelled modern regular script. Absent stages are omitted.
sources.interpretation: Source-labelled specimens are not a universal chronological chain. Traditional source forms and modern simplified forms are distinguished. Dictionary sourceAnalysis is attributed wording, not an independent historical verification.
sources.storagePolicy: Cached source-page receipts retain their original checked date and page hash; expansion processing is not a new network check. New local SVG files carry source and sanitized byte hashes. Remote failures remain links.
sources.displayPolicy: Display locally retained SVGs only. Every stage remains a source-entry association unless independently reviewed. Modern regular script is not ancient writing.

validation.scope: Source-page receipt membership, preserved reviewed representatives, source captions, SVG safety and byte hashes; not an independent historical interpretation review.

dataPolicy.association: Each record contains historical or modern specimens linked by the source dictionary entry, with modern regular script labelled separately. Linkage alone does not establish that a specimen is the modern target character itself, its direct ancestor, or a form belonging to the currently selected vocabulary sense.
dataPolicy.display: Describe these as related specimens linked by the source entry. Do not label an unreviewed specimen as the target character in a historical script, draw a direct source-specimen-to-modern-target evolution arrow, or use it as an identity quiz answer without separate character-specific evidence.
dataPolicy.sourceIndexLabels: A non-PUA unified Han codepoint in a Shuowen SVG filename may be shown as the source asset index character. This is an index label, not independent proof of etymological identity. Oracle-bone and bronze PUA filename numbers are resource identifiers, not characters to decode into a modern target.
dataPolicy.traditional: The traditional field preserves the first value of the source entry variant list. It is not a reviewed one-to-one traditional conversion for the selected HSK word or sense. Simplified character mergers and multiple senses can point to different traditional forms.
dataPolicy.counts: Historical coverage counts dictionary entries linking to historical specimens and excludes modern regular script. It is not a count of target characters with independently verified direct historical evolution.
dataPolicy.ko: 원문 항목에 함께 실린 옛 글자 자료입니다. 학습 글자 자체의 직접적인 변천이나 현재 뜻을 입증하지는 않습니다.
dataPolicy.modern: 楷书 is a separately labelled modern regular-script reference. It is never counted as an ancient specimen or used to fill an absent historical period.
dataPolicy.sequence: 楚系简帛 and 秦系简牍 are distinct source/material traditions, not a universal linear chronological chain.
dataPolicy.sourceExplanation: Quoted Shuowen original text is stored separately from sourceAnalysis. Its indexed headword and dictionary cross-reference status do not establish a one-to-one relation to the current vocabulary sense.

previousSelectedStageValidation.scope: Exact source-page and same-stage gallery membership, captions, page hashes, raw/local asset hashes and SVG safety; not an independent historical interpretation review.
